age.evidence: Here, we report on the in vivo interactome of NXT2 in the human adult testis and demonstrate a specific association with key components of the nuclear export machinery, including not only NXF1 but also the testis-specifically expressed NXF1 paralogues NXF2 and NXF3 and nuclear pore complex proteins NUP93 and NUP214.
